notes: Refined existing stories for clarity, boundary enforcement, and non-duplication. No new IDs created.

change_log.value: Harden Pydantic models to enforce strict input/output schema (query, specialty, geo, filters, ranked providers, scores, metadata) with validation, normalization, and zero business logic leakage.
change_log.note: Clarify contract scope and remove ambiguity

change_log.value: Implement provider_search_service pipeline: embedding generation, MongoDB Atlas vector search, score threshold evaluation, deterministic fallback to NUCC taxonomy, and staged geo filtering (state→city→county).

Wire provider search through find_care_facade and tool_router with clear separation: input prep (specialty_service, query expansion), execution (provider_search_service), and response shaping without duplicating domain logic.
Add unit and integration tests validating ranking determinism, threshold-triggered fallback, geo filtering stages, and edge cases (no hits, low-confidence matches, invalid inputs).
Validate end-to-end alignment between offline embeddings (DataPipelines) and runtime retrieval: index integrity, embedding consistency, and environment parity (dev/qa/prod).
